reasons: The normalized real-driver delta was 0.10, below the preregistered 0.20 threshold.
Four of sixty case runs timed out, so runtime metadata was incomplete.
Negative cases forbid their own requested domain words, confounding correct skill non-activation with refusal to perform the user task.
The completed run shared a repository cwd across samples; agent-created files were visible to later cases, so independence was contaminated.
next_action: Repair the case corpus in a new bounded plan and use the driver's ephemeral per-invocation cwd with codex --skip-git-repo-check, then run a newly preregistered ablation; do not rerun this plan a fourth time.
